content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To make milk tea, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Purchase loose leaf black tea (30 minutes)
Step 2. Clean the tea kettle (5 minutes)
Step 3. Measure out the brown sugar (1 minute)
Step 4. Fetch the tapioca pearls from the pantry (30 seconds)
Step 5. Rinse the tea leaves to remove dust (10 seconds)
Step 6. Sterilize the serving glasses (10 minutes)
Step 7. Dissolve the sugar into the hot tea base (2 minutes)
Step 8. Sort through tea leaves for quality (5 minutes)
Step 9. Measure the exact weight of tea leaves (2 minutes)
Step 10. Garnish the cups with a mint leaf (30 seconds)
Step 11. Prepare a heat-proof pitcher (2 minutes)
Step 12. Set out the long stirring spoons (30 seconds)
Step 13. Place coasters on the table (1 minute)
Step 14. Select the appropriate boba straws (1 minute)
Step 15. Prepare the ice cube trays (5 minutes)
Step 16. Clear a space on the kitchen counter (2 minutes)

Step 19. Wipe down the prep area (3 minutes)
Step 20. Combine the brewed tea and cooked pearls (1 minute)
Step 21. Whisk the milk into the sweetened tea (2 minutes)
Step 22. Label the cups for different sweetness levels (2 minutes)
Step 23. Find the recipe book (4 minutes)
Step 24. Put the flour back in the cupboard (1 minute)
Step 25. Open the tea packaging (15 seconds)

Step 33. Check the expiration date on the milk (30 seconds)
Step 34. Strain the tea leaves from the liquid (2 minutes)
Step 35. Place the ice trays in the freezer (4 hours)
Step 36. Cook the tapioca pearls in the boiling water (20 minutes)
Step 37. Take a photo of the finished drink (1 minute)
Step 38. Add the ice cubes to the glasses (30 seconds)
Step 39. Taste the tea for strength (30 seconds)
Step 40. Get the honey jar ready (1 minute)

Step 47. Crack the ice cubes out of the tray (2 minutes)
